listing.title: My First Yummy Food Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Food Pages – Pizza, Cupcake, Ice Cream, Pancakes & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of yummy food!

Little hands color 30 smiling foods, from pancakes and pizza to a cupcake and a birthday cake. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • Breakfast: Pancakes, Waffle, Toast, Egg, Cereal, Muffin, Croissant, Milk, Yogurt and Honey
  • Lunch and dinner: Pizza, Sandwich, Taco, Burger, Hot Dog, French Fries, Spaghetti, Bread, Cheese and Juice Box
  • Sweet treats: Cupcake, Ice Cream, Donut, Cookie, Pie, Jelly, Popcorn, Lollipop, Birthday Cake and Ice Pop
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
